Title: [LSJ] Madness Network, Major Boon, Spying Mission

Messages.Author: JH
Messages.Body:
If I bleed my prey during another Methuselah's turn with the help of
Madness Network and play Major Boon when the bleed is successful can I
play Spying Mission after Major Boon to reduce the pool amount I lose
to 0?

Messages.Author: floppyzedolfin
Messages.Body:
On 13 mar, 13:51, "JH" <jhatt...@tenerdo.org> wrote:
> If I bleed my prey during another Methuselah's turn with the help of
> Madness Network and play Major Boon when the bleed is successful can I
> play Spying Mission after Major Boon to reduce the pool amount I lose
> to 0?

Major Boon specifies "Not usable if you control the acting minion."
